issues.quote: net income grew 19.4% to $13.8 billion in fiscal 2023 versus $12.6 billion a year earlier
issues.problem: Tesla's FY2023 net income was about $15.0B ($14.997B), not $13.8B. The 19.4% growth rate fits $15.0B against $12.6B, but $13.8B would mean only about 9.5% growth. The 2023 figure also includes a one-time tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a valuation allowance, so 'profitability kept pace' overstates the underlying trend.

data.summary: Revenue, assets, liabilities, cash and operating cash flow figures are correct. The FY2023 net income figure is wrong: it should be about $15.0B, not $13.8B, and the stated figure doesn't match the stated 19.4% growth rate.
